调用链：benchmark_fixture → temp fixture backend → run_benchmark → measure_case → CodeIndexBackend::call_tool → in-process MCP tool_index → build_index_scoped → prepare/write/postprocess/apply。case `index_build` 是 `full=true`，因此 warm 的同 session 并不使索引变成 no-op。每个 case 是丢弃 1 warmup、测 2 次取较小值，再跨 case 求 percentile；此处单 case 的 p95 就是这个较小值，**不是大量重复独立采样的 p95**。[crates/cc-eval/corpus/index_build.toml:L1](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/corpus/index_build.toml#L1)、[crates/cc-eval/src/bench.rs:L57](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/src/bench.rs#L57)、[crates/cc-eval/src/bench.rs:L113](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/src/bench.rs#L113)、[crates/cc-eval/src/runner.rs:L154](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/src/runner.rs#L154)、[crates/cc-server/src/mcp.rs:L143](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/mcp.rs#L143)、[crates/cc-server/src/handlers/core.rs:L74](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/handlers/core.rs#L74)。

既有单跑原 500ms 断言通过 1/0，warm index 314.93ms/cold 407.82ms（原日志 L26、L39–41）；manifest 记录原失败时 concurrent baseline build，README 记录单跑发生在其它构建结束后。这支持负载敏感假设，不能由一组前后值证明 CPU/I/O 的具体因果，也不能排除源码性能变化。没有逐阶段耗时/同期资源时间线。**不以单跑 pass 改写原失败，不建议调大阈值。** [原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#fixture-isolated)；[artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json:L46](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/6db4d396e5d994388ada1e97c3d28947ffdb9c81/artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json#L46)、[artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/README.md:L15](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/6db4d396e5d994388ada1e97c3d28947ffdb9c81/artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/README.md#L15)。

## 2. partial_backfill_allows_model_switch_and_new_space_progress — 已在 PR101 存在的失败形态

目标 `-p cc-eval --test semantic_lifecycle`，全量 `semantic_lifecycle-5af432fe168f2d97`。原日志 L1195–1215，panic `semantic_lifecycle.rs:297:19`：`replacement backfill must finish and old worker physically exit: Elapsed(())`；suite 1/1，5.28s。[原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#all-features-complete-no-fail-fast)；[crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs:L265](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs#L265)。

调用链：run_cases(true) → HeldProvider/FakeProvider 阻塞旧 worker → 真实 local query/修改/删除/build → 写 fake/new config → set_project（旧 worker close）→ install_semantic_provider（新 worker 获得 configured transition 授权）→ build(false)/schedule → release old provider → poll `coverage.published > 0 && index.query_pins() == 0`。旧与新 project 同路径共享 QueryServices；schedule 持有全局 2-slot capacity 和 pin，直到 blocking 工作实际退出；run_round 先准备 configured space，再 backfill/enqueue/drain/publish。这些是静态约束，**不是本次失败的线程轨迹**。[crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs:L250](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs#L250)、[crates/cc-server/src/engine.rs:L203](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/engine.rs#L203)、[crates/cc-server/src/engine.rs:L302](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/engine.rs#L302)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L162](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L162)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L263](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L263)。

既有 v24 isolated 仍 1/1，5.19s，但 executable 是 `semantic_lifecycle-b098cfbe2728d0f7`，不能未经 receipt 宣称其 feature 完全相同。PR101 既有对照 `index-fix-target-base101-features`、同全量 deps 标识 `5af432fe168f2d97`，同源码行/消息，1/1、5.34s；“matching features”另有 manifest 明示。因而此失败形态已在修复前存在，不能直接计为 v24 新回归。[原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#lifecycle-isolated)、[原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#base101-lifecycle)；[artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json:L48](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/6db4d396e5d994388ada1e97c3d28947ffdb9c81/artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json#L48)。

最小已证根因边界：**5s 内组合完成谓词未满足**。日志不输出失败时 coverage/pin/provider call/worker last_error，不能区分未发布、旧/新 pin 未释放、transition/retry/cache IO。测试可选 receipt 仅在设置 CODECORTEX_LIFECYCLE_RECEIPT_DIR 时写；final-v24 中没有该次 model-switch receipt。不能从此项 timeout 判定死锁、capacity 饥饿或借用另目标的 EROFS。[crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs:L54](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs#L54)、[crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs:L285](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-eval/tests/semantic_lifecycle.rs#L285)。

## 3. semantic_runtime::tests::post_index_worker_crosses_pages_and_reopen_reuses_artifacts — 权限/文件系统硬阻塞

目标 `-p cc-server --lib`，`cc_server-0c12bb93deec97e6`。原日志 L3247–3261：panic `semantic_runtime.rs:792:9`，`coverage.uncovered == 0` 左 1100/右 0；eligible1100/published0/failed0/stale0/reasonNone；`errors=cache put failed: IO error: Read-only file system (os error 30); worker=None`，suite 327/1/1。该断言在等待 worker idle 后，尚未执行 reopen/cache reuse 后半段。[原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#all-features-complete-no-fail-fast)；[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L739](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L739)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L776](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L776)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L802](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L802)。

调用链：1100 合成文件 → CodeIndex + FakeProvider → core::build_index → SemanticRuntime::schedule/run_round_with → semantic_wiring::drain_worker_batch → queue::drain_pending_with_lifecycle / EmbedHandler::handle → FencedProvider::embed_documents → Publisher::publish_embedding → ArtifactCache::put → mkdir/atomic write（payload、meta）。Publisher 把 put 错误变成 ArtifactNotVerified；handler 转 NeedsRetry，queue 将 reason 写到 durable retry，因而 `worker=None` **不表示无失败**，uncovered 也不必等于 failed。[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L363](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L363)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_wiring.rs:L539](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_wiring.rs#L539)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs:L427](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs#L427)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/publish.rs:L121](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/publish.rs#L121)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/cache.rs:L444](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/cache.rs#L444)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs:L332](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs#L332)。

**已证直接阻断是 cache put 返回 EROFS，不是性能阈值或 provider 质量。** 测试 temp source/DB 可写不保证 artifact 根可写：assemble 按显式 cache env、HOME/XDG 的解析结果开独立 ArtifactCache，open 无写副作用，首次 put 才写。日志没有失败的具体路径、挂载信息或 syscall，不能断言哪个 mkdir/write/rename 被拒，也不能声称精确目录已证。[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_wiring.rs:L284](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_wiring.rs#L284)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/cache.rs:L184](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/cache.rs#L184)。权限硬阻塞记录保留；本任务不重试、不换根/权限。[artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json:L49](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/6db4d396e5d994388ada1e97c3d28947ffdb9c81/artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json#L49)。

## 4. close_after_response_before_publish_still_fences_old_worker — 未归因；可能新回归待证

目标 `-p cc-server --test p7_runtime_independent_review`，`p7_runtime_independent_review-158a04a8710afada`；原日志 L3746–3767，panic `p7_runtime_independent_review.rs:268:6`：`durable artifact proves provider returned past its close check: Elapsed(())`，suite 2/1、2.24s。确切等待是 2s 内 cache.get 从 Miss 变 Hit（非最终 `published == 0`）。[原始上下文及 raw 行号](context-index.md#all-features-complete-no-fail-fast)；[crates/cc-server/tests/p7_runtime_independent_review.rs:L234](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/tests/p7_runtime_independent_review.rs#L234)。

调用链：fixture(1)/HeldProvider → build_and_wait（已进入 provider）→ 确认初始 Miss → SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE → release provider → poll cache Hit → **之后才** close/ROLLBACK/wait_pins/最终发布 fence 断言。原失败停在 Hit 等待，未到达 close 行275–277，故不证明 close fence 失效、迟到发布或 GC/WAL 问题。provider 返回后静态路径是 FencedProvider close check → EmbedHandler → Publisher cache put/readback → DB CAS；artifact 在 CAS 前落地。[crates/cc-server/tests/p7_runtime_independent_review.rs:L250](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/tests/p7_runtime_independent_review.rs#L250)、[crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs:L422](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-server/src/semantic_runtime.rs#L422)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs:L457](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/queue.rs#L457)、[crates/cc-semantic/src/publish.rs:L121](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/9ebdb155c64e094b3d774be41dbe7ab8c4e222c1/crates/cc-semantic/src/publish.rs#L121)。

仅已证 **窗口内未观察到 Hit**。候选包括 provider release 后尚未返回、cache IO 不可写/慢、worker 其它退出/调度原因；这些均待证。另一目标有 EROFS，而本项没有路径/last_error/时序证明，不能合并归因。SQLite writer contention 是测试自设边界，不能仅凭 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 把 timeout 定为 DB 锁死。没有本项 PR101 对照原日志；选定调用链无源码变更也不足以排除依赖变化。故“可能新回归”只表示尚未排除，**不是已确认新回归**；不抬高 2s 阈值。[artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json:L47](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/6db4d396e5d994388ada1e97c3d28947ffdb9c81/artifacts/checkpoints/index-fix-integration-20261003/final-v24/validation-log-manifest.json#L47)。
